text: Fill in the correct directional term in each sentence.
questions: The sternum is *anterior:Which surface of the body is the sternum on?* to the heart.
The elbow is *proximal:Which joint is closer to the trunk?* to the wrist.
In the leg, the tibia is *medial:Which bone is nearer the median plane?* to the fibula.
The diaphragm is *inferior:Which structure is nearer the feet?* to the lungs.
The sole of the foot is called the *plantar:Recall the special term for the underside of the foot.* surface.

overallFeedback.feedback: Each directional term describes one structure's position relative to another in the anatomical position: anterior means nearer the front, proximal means nearer the trunk along a limb, medial means nearer the median plane, inferior means nearer the feet, and plantar is the sole surface of the foot (with dorsum opposite).
